name: serio-focus
description: Serio NGO's AI dev lifecycle for Claude Code and Codex: a spec review, locked tests, code and fixes by architect, tester, coder and reviewer agents, with three human gates, by hand or in GitHub Actions. Short focused replies for neurodivergent readers. Its scripts make no model calls and need no API key or runtime dependency.

scripts.test: node --test && node plugins/serio-focus/scripts/lifecycle/route.mjs --self-test && node plugins/serio-focus/scripts/lifecycle/lock.mjs --self-test && node plugins/serio-focus/scripts/lifecycle/acceptance.mjs --self-test && node plugins/serio-focus/scripts/lifecycle/publish.mjs --self-test && node plugins/serio-focus/scripts/lifecycle/brief.mjs --self-test
